meta.title: Cluega IM vs Pancake | Cluega
meta.description: Pancake is good at keeping messages and orders across many pages under control; Cluega IM goes one step further — automatically merging the same buyer's cross-channel footprint at the identity layer, turning private-domain conversations into attributable, billable sales data.

hero.title: Trace every Zalo sale back to the exact TikTok ad it came from
hero.subtitle: Pancake is good at keeping messages and orders across many pages under control, and it can send events back to ad platforms; Cluega IM goes one step further — automatically merging the same buyer's cross-channel footprint at the identity layer, turning private-domain conversations into attributable, billable sales data. Your own lead-capture rules define the conversion scale, so every dollar of ad budget lines up with a real sale.

whySwitch.title: Why performance teams still need Cluega IM on top of Pancake

items.title: One buyer across three apps, one sale counted once
items.body: Pancake CRM can send events back to Meta／Google／TikTok, but when the same buyer shows up on Zalo, LINE and WhatsApp, that's three IDs that don't know each other — in practice you match phone numbers by hand, and the smallest mismatch means double counting. Cluega IM automatically merges that buyer's cross-channel behaviour at the identity layer: the customer clicks in from a TikTok ad, adds you on Zalo, and pays in DMs three days later — that sale points back to the original campaign, adset and creative, counted once and never billed twice.

items.title: You define the scale, and every level carries its reasoning
items.body: What ad platforms can receive is a list of preset events, triggered or not by rules. What Cluega IM gives you is a continuous scale: a large model reads the semantics of each conversation and places it in real time against the lead-capture rules you set — phone number left is L2, appointment booked is L3, payment completed is L6. The difference isn't whether events "can be sent back", it's that every level carries its reasoning, is auditable and billable, and can also go back to the ad platform as a conversion signal.

items.title: Ads that bring orders, and ads that bring conversations that will close
items.body: Filtering ad IDs backwards from an order report only shows you the end that already closed; conversations still in progress have nowhere to sit. Cluega IM computes true ROAS at sales-stage granularity: a conversation that reached L3／L4 but hasn't paid still has value, so a media buyer sees not just "which ad has produced orders" but "which ad deserves more budget" — instead of only surface metrics like DM volume and new friend counts.

items.title: Performance fees only on closed sales, so billing is aligned with you
items.body: Beyond the subscription, AI-managed selling is settled on the conversation's final MMT state: unconverted conversations only carry a base fee that covers compute, and you pay the matching performance fee only when the AI genuinely pushes the conversation into the sales tier. Your bill always tracks performance, never message volume.

steps: AI identifies pain points, keeps engaging

highlights.title: Not just managing messages and orders — owning full-funnel data across global private domains

items.title: Every channel covered
items.body: Conversations and sales events from Zalo・LINE・WhatsApp・Messenger land in a single customer profile, so attribution never breaks when the channel changes.

items.title: MMT L0–L6 funnel
items.body: Every conversation is placed into a sales stage automatically; from high-intent chat to completed payment, every funnel layer is visible and countable.

items.title: Data sovereignty
items.body: Every attribution carries an auditable log, and events are written back in a closed loop via API／Webhook／postback; customer data never leaves and is never used for cross-tenant training.

items.title: Team collaboration
items.body: Supports API／MCP and human-in-the-loop work; manual intervention is bounded by the handoff timestamp, so credit for the AI and for your agents is counted cleanly.

pancake.label: Choose Pancake
pancake.body: Your core pain is high-volume customer service, order taking, inventory and fulfilment, and you need a mature e-commerce operations back office; your send-back needs are mostly standard events, you don't need custom sales-stage scales or automatic cross-channel identity merging, and you don't need billing tied to performance.

cluega.label: Choose Cluega IM
cluega.body: You grow through advertising across TikTok／Meta／Google, you need to know which ad each private-domain sale came from, you need the same buyer never billed twice across platforms, and you want billing perfectly aligned with performance.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before you reach out to our team.

items.q: We already use Pancake — can we layer Cluega IM on top?
items.a: Yes, and it's a common pairing. Pancake keeps handling customer service and order operations while Cluega IM focuses on the attribution layer: connect the same channels and you can start pushing private-domain sales back to ads. The two complement each other, and you don't need to migrate your existing workflow.

items.q: How does cross-platform attribution from TikTok to Zalo actually work?
items.a: Cluega IM merges ad click parameters, conversation events and captured identity (phone number／social ID) into a single customer profile at the identity layer. The same customer is counted per channel for conversations but merged for attribution — one sale counts once, and still points back to its ad source.

items.q: Can the conversion definition be customised?
items.a: Yes. The business reading of MMT L1–L6 is configured from your own lead-capture and sales rules: you can map "phone number left", "appointment booked" and "payment info added" to explicit levels, and both billing and reporting follow your definitions.

items.q: Can we use it before connecting our order system back?
items.a: Yes. For non-closed-loop customers without sales write-back, billing is capped at the observable lead-capture stage (MMT L3／L4), or switched to subscription + a committed package; once API／Webhook write-back is in place you can enable full L5／L6 sales billing, so you're never "billed for sales you can't see".
